title: NSS for Cloud & Branch Connector: how connector logs reach a SIEM
aliases: nss for firewall cloud and branch connector

prose.text: Cloud and Branch Connector logs leave the Zscaler cloud for a SIEM through the Nanolog Streaming Service. This subject says what is needed and walks to the server, feed and forwarding-path subjects.

prose.label: What it is.
prose.text: {{what-nss-is}} {{log-types}} The fields of each log type are in [[cloud-connector.logs]].

prose.label: Servers and feeds.
prose.text: Registering the VM, its certificate, buffering and sizing are in [[cloud-connector.nss-va.servers]]. Feed limits, output formats and the SIEM destination are in [[cloud-connector.nss-va.feeds]]. How the connector's own Log and Control Forwarding policy relates to this path is in [[cloud-connector.nss-va.log-control-path]].

prose.label: Cloud NSS.
prose.text: Whether the HTTPS-push Cloud NSS carries Cloud and Branch Connector logs is open {{gap:cloud-nss-for-cbc}}. The NSS model shared with ZIA (Nanolog tunnel, one-hour recovery, Cloud NSS) is in [[shared.nss.delivery-modes]].

checks.do: Whether the tenant holds the NSS for Firewall, Cloud and Branch Connector subscription before troubleshooting a missing feed.
Which log type the SIEM is missing (Session, DNS, Event or Metrics), since each has its own feed.

what-nss-is.statement: For Cloud & Branch Connector, NSS uses a VM to stream traffic logs in real time from the Zscaler Nanolog to a SIEM, and an NSS server is the representation of that VM in the Admin Console.

quotes: The Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) uses a virtual machine (VM) to stream traffic logs in real time from the Zscaler Nanolog to your security information and event management (SIEM) system
An NSS server is the representation of the NSS VM in the Zscaler Admin Console.

log-types.statement: Both Cloud Connector and Branch Connector can generate Session, DNS, Event and Metrics logs, and an NSS feed specifies which log data the NSS sends to the SIEM.

quotes: Both Cloud Connector and Branch Connector can generate Session, DNS, Event, and Metrics logs.
A Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) feed specifies the data from the logs that the NSS sends to the security information and event management (SIEM) system.

subscription.statement: Managing Cloud & Branch Connector NSS requires a subscription to NSS for Firewall, Cloud and Branch Connector.

quotes: You must be subscribed to NSS for Firewall, Cloud and Branch Connector to manage your Cloud & Branch Connector NSS.

firewall-config-only.statement: The NSS VM is deployed from the NSS deployment guides for Azure, AWS and vSphere; for Cloud & Branch Connector only their NSS for Firewall configurations apply, and the NSS for Web configurations are to be ignored as not applicable.

quotes: For Cloud & Branch Connector, consider only the NSS for Firewall configurations in the deployment guides and ignore the NSS for Web configurations because they are not applicable.

cloud-nss-for-cbc.title: Whether Cloud NSS carries Cloud and Branch Connector logs
cloud-nss-for-cbc.blocks: choosing between an NSS VM and Cloud NSS for a cloud-hosted SIEM
cloud-nss-for-cbc.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "A Cloud NSS for Firewall subscription covers CBC log types" and Cloud NSS is "the lower-friction path when the SIEM exposes a publicly routable HTTPS ingestion API". The captured Cloud & Branch Connector NSS articles describe only NSS servers (VMs) and NSS feeds; the Cloud NSS articles are written for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) log types.

quotes: You can optionally subscribe to Cloud NSS, enabling direct cloud-to-cloud log streaming for all Internet & SaaS (ZIA) log types into a compatible cloud-based SIEM without any on-premises connectors.
